storage.description: Budgets that warn in vcr status, vcr validate and vcr storage; nothing is ever deleted automatically (plugin PRD §6.5)

models.description: The model each agent runs on in this workspace, keyed by agent name (ADR 0013). A value is a model name, or one name per host where they differ. An agent not listed uses the model in its own definition. VCR reports this map and never checks a name: only the host knows what it accepts
